caseName: Capital Cities Cable, Inc. v. Crisp
caseNameFull: Capital Cities Cable, Inc. v. Crisp, Director, Oklahoma Alcoholic Beverage Control Board

opinions.text: C. A. 10th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 813.] Motion of petitioners for divided argument denied. Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae, for divided argument, and for additional time for oral argument denied.
